channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war day 106: US and Iran say deal close but Lebanon fighting continues
item.description: US and Iran say a deal to end the war is close, with a final text agreed but key steps still pending.

item.title: One killed as Israel hits south Lebanon, issues forced displacement orders
item.description: The Israeli military has ordered residents of 20 Lebanese towns and villages to leave their homes immediately.

item.title: Trump seeks ‘off-ramp’ from war in ‘Iran deal’
item.description: As reports emerge of a possible US-Iran agreement, President Donald Trump is looking for an ‘off-ramp’ from Iran war.

item.title: Trump says US strike killed Tren de Aragua gang boss with Venezuelan help
item.description: Gang leader Flores had controlled the vast criminal syndicate from Venezuela for years.

item.title: Deal to end fighting would lead to Hormuz reopening, Iran says
item.description: The deal which will pave the way for hostilities to end is close to being finalised, the US, Iran and mediators Pakistan say.

item.title: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in airstrike, Trump says
item.description: Niño Guerrero was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike," the US President wrote in a social media post.

item.title: 'I will come home safely': Indian sailor's last words to wife before a US strike killed him
item.description: Patnala Suresh and his wife were looking forward to celebrating their 15th wedding anniversary this month.

item.title: More than 50 Iranian military bases damaged in US strikes since start of war, satellite images show
item.description: Bases across Iran have been hit by US strikes, with experts identifying damage to jets and warships.

item.title: Flip flop or deliberate? - Unpacking Trump’s strategy on Iran
item.description: The BBC's Gary O'Donoghue looks at the US president's mixed messaging over the war and the questions it raises.
